$comment: Keen verification gates. pnpm verify runs the fast tier, pnpm verify:build the build tier, pnpm verify:live the live tier. Every gate in tools/token-generator/src/gates.ts must be listed here.

gates.description: token files are valid DTCG with tiers, types, units, descriptions, and resolvable references
generated CSS and typed map are deterministic and match the token sources
the committed resolved-token baseline matches the token sources
every Component Contract contrast pair passes in light and dark
design/keen.variables.json holds exactly the Pen variables the tokens generate
design/keen.pen's variables, read through the pen CLI, match the tokens
no component forwards className or style onto its internals
component code reads only generated semantic and component tokens: no primitives, no phantoms
every token a component reads is listed in its Component Contract
component motion applies named uses with no literal durations or easings, animates only opacity, transform, and colors, and registers every loop and entrance
the generated reduced-motion rules collapse semantic durations to 0.01ms, park registered loops, and stay scoped to Keen's root
generated JavaScript timings match their tokens, and motion and icon tokens are in the baseline
every ds-allow(<category>): <reason> directive names a known category
.keen/design/icons.json was read from the current design/keen.pen
design/keen.pen's icon nodes, read through the pen CLI, match .keen/design/icons.json
only the generated registry imports Lucide, and component code names only registered glyphs
the packed package exports only ./react, ./styles.css, and ./tokens, and internals are not importable
apps/fixture-astro installs the packed package, themes it page-wide through semantic tokens that reach the component tokens aliasing them, and builds
Storybook builds and indexes the token-sample and motion replay stories
the token-sample story renders every semantic color role with its resolved light and dark value
durations equal their tokens and become 0.01ms with reduced motion from the OS or the toolbar, scrolling jumps, and no loop or entrance runs
in apps/fixture-astro, the host's own transition is unchanged under reduced motion
